lineage.description: IPC classification data were collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly schedule across Zambia in 2017. Geographic boundaries and classification scales were recorded for different food security scenarios, with collection dates and period dates documented to track temporal changes in acute food insecurity conditions.
